item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00031","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C12","C06","C03"],"selected_candidate_label":"C12","confidence":0.97,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C12 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template for the child's central administrative machinery. Its Bureau of the Budget provisions assign nearly the same three functions later assigned to the Director for statistical improvement: assisting agencies, arranging solutions to interagency problems, and promoting interchange of useful information. The child preserves this sequence and adapts it from general management improvement to statistical work. C06 is also highly relevant because it uses the same Director-centered machinery for statistical information, agency consultation, regulations, and a prior-order conflict rule, but it does not match the child's core operative triad as closely as C12. C03 has related interagency data-management, prioritization, resource, and consultation provisions but substantially less distinctive overlap.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The Director ... shall (a) provide for the interchange of information calculated to improve statistical work, (b) make appropriate arrangements for improving statistical work involving relationships between two or more agencies, and (c) assist the agencies, by other means, to improve their statistical work.","parent_excerpt":"The Bureau of the Budget shall ... (b) advise and assist the agencies in working out programs to improve their operations, (c) make appropriate arrangements for handling program and operating problems of an interagency nature, (d) provide for an interchange of information on effective management techniques","explanation":"This is a distinctive, nearly clause-for-clause reuse of the same three-part administrative mechanism, with reordered clauses and the target changed from management generally to statistical work."},{"child_excerpt":"maintain a continuing study for the improvement of the statistical work of the agencies ... with a view to obtaining the maximum benefit from the funds and facilities available","parent_excerpt":"provide for periodic and systematic appraisals of operations to identify opportunities to improve effectiveness and performance ... giving priority to the activities promising greatest benefits in economy or better service for the same or less money","explanation":"Both establish continuing or systematic review aimed at improving executive-agency performance and maximizing benefits from available resources."},{"child_excerpt":"The Director of the Bureau of the Budget ... shall develop programs ... for the improved gathering, compiling, analyzing, publishing, and disseminating of statistical information","parent_excerpt":"The Bureau of the Budget shall ... advise and assist the agencies in working out programs to improve their operations","explanation":"The child narrows C12's government-wide management-improvement program machinery to a specialized government-wide statistical-improvement program."}]}
